about_the_game:
Brews & Blood

A harrowing one-night shift in a liquor shop, where the curse of the Red Moon unravels in a forsaken Indian village.

Story:

Your uncle calls you for a last-minute favor—he needs you to cover a one-night shift at his liquor shop in a remote Indian village. You can't refuse, as he has helped you countless times before. But this is no ordinary night. As fate would have it, tonight marks the rise of the Red Moon, a night steeped in an ancient village curse.

Gameplay:

  • First-Person Horror Simulation: Manage the liquor shop, serve customers, and complete small tasks—until the horror takes over.

  • Deep Atmospheric Horror: A slow-burn experience where fear creeps in through eerie silence, disturbing visuals, and unsettling encounters.

  • Horror Chase Sequences: As the curse takes hold, terrifying entities will hunt you—run, hide, or find a way to fight back.

  • Car Driving Mechanics: Escape through the haunted village in a desperate drive for survival, but the roads may not lead where you expect.

One shift. One cursed night. Will you survive the horrors of the Red Moon?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 Ti or or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660Ti 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: On the night of the Red Moon, you take over your uncle’s liquor shop in a remote Indian village as a favor. What starts as a routine shift soon spirals into a night of terror. Will you survive until dawn?
